probe: What minimum durable state preserves exact duplicate safety and useful completion when a bounded compact frontier crosses an atomic-effect boundary?

candidate_comparison.same_transaction_effect_plus_frontier: BEST when effect and frontier share one transactional resource: all-or-nothing commit and compact frontier remain exact; any external side effect outside that transaction stays unresolved.
candidate_comparison.deterministic_sink_plus_certificate: CONDITIONAL when sink identity/idempotency and terminal evidence persist for the full retry/non-reuse horizon. Provider idempotency caches with bounded retention do not prove indefinite exactness.
candidate_comparison.transactional_outbox_inbox: LOCAL dual-write is repaired, but duplicate downstream delivery remains unless the consumer/sink is idempotent or keeps dedup state; therefore outbox alone is not compact end-to-end exactness.
candidate_comparison.conservative_burn_after_ambiguous_crash: Duplicate-safe but insufficient for useful-outcome parity because an actually-failed effect can be permanently suppressed unless success is distinguishable from burn/unknown.

minimum_durable_state: one shared high-water mark H or structurally bounded K active frontiers
a monotonically fenced epoch/token bound to each in-flight identity
for each at-most-K ambiguous identity, terminal state sufficient to distinguish committed-success from burned/unknown when authoritative effect readback is unavailable
a deterministic effect identity/resource reference or compact completion certificate until terminal closure
semantic_conclusion.collapse_rule: After authoritative closure, fold the identity into H/closed epoch and delete per-identity state; extra state stays O(K) when ambiguity is structurally bounded.
semantic_conclusion.stale_writer_rule: Stale writers are excluded only if both frontier commit and effect sink honor the current fence, or the effect is deterministically idempotent under an identity the stale writer cannot validly reuse.
semantic_conclusion.external_effect_boundary: If an external effect is neither in the same transaction nor durably idempotent/authoritatively readable, exact useful completion remains unresolved even with an exact local frontier.
semantic_conclusion.burn_rule: Burning an ambiguous identity prevents duplicate reuse but cannot by itself prove the useful effect occurred.
